name: Anoop Bikram Shahi
bio: Anoop Bikram Shahi (born July 23, 1985)is a prominent Nepali actor and model. His career took off after winning the Manhunt International Nepal title in 2013, going on to represent his country at the international competition in Shenzhen, China. A major milestone in his acting career occurred when he won the D Cine Award and NFDC National Film Award for Best Actor in a Negative Role for his performance in the action film Hasiya, establishing him as one of Nepal's premiere cinematic villains. Over the years, he has starred in major Nepali feature films including Bir Bikram, Kri, Purano Bullet, Password, and Lakhey. Beyond film, he expanded his reach to television as a prominent gang leader on the hit reality show Himalaya Roadies.
